description: Self-signed EC (P-256) certificate for 192.0.2.10 (TEST-NET-1, never a real controller) generated with `openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -noenc -days 3650 -subj /CN=omada-fixture-controller -addext subjectAltName=IP:192.0.2.10` (private key discarded). `sha256` is the fingerprint computed independently by `openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256`; computeCertificateFingerprint() (src/main/cert-pinning.ts) must produce exactly this.
